- Handler interface for processing analysis results
- CaptureHandler that triggers clip export on detections
- Handler chain for multiple detection processors
- Extended AudioManager interface with SetCaptureManager support
- Updated adapter to configure capture for each audio source
- Memory-efficient buffer management without pooling for large audio chunks
- Proper error handling with enhanced error context

functionality from myaudio to audiocore while maintaining compatibility
and adding new capabilities for multi-source audio processing.
